data.narrative:
Mach Industries is a Series B defense and security company founded by Ethan Thornton, which has raised $185M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies spanning the Defense & Security sector: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $352M. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables establishes a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The five named peers anchor this range: Dream Security at $3.0B (high), Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Defense Unicorns and Heven AeroTech both at $1.0B.

Triangulating both methods yields a valuation range of $299M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $738M. The wide band reflects meaningful dispersion in peer valuations within the defense and security segment at this stage. Key uncertainties center on Mach's relative positioning within the peer set on product maturity, revenue traction, and customer concentration—factors that explain the $2.7B spread observed across comparable companies.
